name: imf_get_databases
description:
List the IMF's current dataflows (its databases) live from the IMF SDMX API, without the dated vintage copies: WEO World Economic Outlook, CPI, ER exchange rates, MFS_IR interest rates, IL international liquidity, BOP balance of payments, PCPS commodity prices and more. The IMF retired IFS; its series now sit in CPI, ER, MFS_IR, IL and MFS_MA.
Returns: databases (code, agency, version, name), count, source.
Inputs (none required): search (text matched against code or name).
Next: imf_get_dataflows shows a database's key dimensions and codes; imf_get_data reads a series.
Example: {"search": "price"}

search.description: Text to match in the dataflow code or name

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Discover IMF databases including IFS, WEO, BOP, FSI, and more.
